source: B. Shen, T. Someya and Y. Arakawa, Appl. Phys. Lett. 76, 2746 (2000), doi:10.1063/1.126463, Fig. 2: 2DEG mobility (solid circles) and sheet concentration (open circles) of Al0.22Ga0.78N/GaN heterostructures versus the thickness of the Si-doped Al0.22Ga0.78N layer, (a) 300 K and (b) 77 K. The undoped Al0.22Ga0.78N spacer is 3 nm thick in all samples.
method: Symbol centres located as connected components of the embedded 1-bit figure image of the published PDF (896 x 1058 pixels, page 3), axes calibrated on the major tick marks of each panel (located by their length on the frame; the tick labels of the right axis of panel (b) sit about 9 pixels below their ticks). Calibrations: panel (a) left 100 cm^2/Vs per 76 px, right 0.5e13 cm^-2 per 76 px; panel (b) left 500 cm^2/Vs per 62.5 px, right 0.4e13 cm^-2 per 88.5 px. The thickness positions fall on the nominal values. The values were read twice, independently, with agreement within 0.3 percent; the three 300 K mobilities quoted in the text (911, 943, 598) agree within one unit. Estimated reading uncertainty: about 1 percent of each axis range.

text_values.note: The 2DEG values were obtained with a multilayer model that removes the i-GaN layer (text).
